name: rich-rendering-canonical
instr:
Restore Rich's documented console rendering behavior across strings, styled text, and built-in renderables. The governing public authority is the repository's own guides, API references, public docstrings and behavioural comments for the scoped implementation, as they appear in the delivered tree. This instruction does not name which files, functions or behaviours are affected, or how many; establishing that from the documentation is part of the task. That documentation describes how Console options, markup, highlighting, styles, width, and renderable output compose. Preserve documented behavior throughout this connected rendering pipeline.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /workdir/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to carry it out and why, including how you will know it works. Be concrete — the files, names and decisions specific to this codebase, not generalities. Complete the document before you touch any code: it is the record of your up-front investigation and decisions, and it should not be rewritten to match whatever the implementation turns into afterwards. Once it is done, implement the plan.
